request.content:
/**
 * User-facing labels of the machine-session concept.
 *
 * The concept used to be called "computer sessions"; it is now called
 * "Machines". The section/navigation entry is `section` ("Machines"), one entry
 * is `item` ("Machine session"), and `live` ("Live session") is reserved for the
 * running / handoff state of a machine the user has to look at.
 *
 * EVERY user-facing string that names the concept must come from this module so
 * that a future rename is one edit here instead of a tree-wide search and
 * replace. It holds display strings only: never use these values as ids, route
 * names, API/model fields, store keys or i18n keys — those keep their current
 * names on purpose (backwards compatibility).
 *
 * Placeholders in `{name}` form are filled in by `label(key, vars)`.
 */

export const SESSION_LABELS = Object.freeze({
  // ── Section / navigation ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  section: 'Machines',
  sectionHint: 'Your machines and their live desktops',

  // ── One item of the section ─────────────────────────────────────────────
  item: 'Machine session',
  items: 'Machine sessions',
  itemShort: 'Machine',
  untitled: 'Machine session',
  newItem: 'New machine session',
  create: 'New machine session',
  createError: 'Could not create the machine session',

  // ── Running / handoff state (never the section name) ────────────────────
  live: 'Live session',
  needsYou: 'Needs you',
  needsYouHint: 'This machine is waiting for you',
  running: 'Running',
  stopped: 'Stopped',

  // ── List states ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  loading: 'Loading machines…',
  empty: 'No machine sessions yet',
  emptyHint: 'Create a machine session to get a desktop with the project files inside',
  loadError: 'Could not load machine sessions',
  loadErrorHint: 'The list of machine sessions could not be fetched',
  retry: 'Retry loading machine sessions',
  retryShort: 'Retry',
  reload: 'Reload machines',
  noSelection: 'Select a machine session',

  // ── Actions (use the {name} placeholder) ────────────────────────────────
  selectItem: 'Select machine session {name}',
  runItem: 'Run machine session {name}',
  editItem: 'Edit machine session {name}',
  deleteItem: 'Delete machine session {name}',
  deleteTitle: 'Delete machine session',
  deleteConfirm: "Delete machine session '{name}'?",
  deleteHint: 'The session, its profile and its desktop state will be removed. This cannot be undone.',

  // ── Views ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  gridPick: 'Pick the machine sessions you want to watch at the same time',
  gridEmpty: 'No machine sessions yet.',
  gridWall: 'Wall of machines',

  // ── Image library of the concept ────────────────────────────────────────
  imageLibrary: 'Machine image library',
  browseImages: 'Browse the machine image library'
})

/**
 * Reads a label by key and fills its `{name}` placeholders.
 *
 * Falls back to the key itself so a typo or a not-yet-migrated caller never
 * renders `undefined` in the UI.
 *
 * @param {string} key key of {@link SESSION_LABELS}
 * @param {Record<string, string|number>} [vars] values for the placeholders
 * @returns {string}
 */
export function label(key, vars) {
  const text = SESSION_LABELS[key] ?? key
  if (!vars) return text
  return String(text).replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (match, name) => (
    vars[name] === undefined || vars[name] === null ? match : String(vars[name])
  ))
}

export default SESSION_LABELS
